name: Half-elf Illusionist 7 (CR 6)
body:
HALF-ELF ILLUSIONIST 7
CR 6

XP 2,400
Half-elf illusionist 7
CN Medium humanoid (elf )
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 deflection, +1 Dex)
hp 30 (7d6)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +7; +2 vs. enchantments
Immune sleep; Resist elven immunities

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +3 (1d4–1/19–20)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; melee touch +2, ranged touch +4):

7/day—blinding ray

Spells Prepared (CL 7th; melee touch +2, ranged touch +4):

4th—dimension door, hallucinatory terrain (DC 18), phantasmal killer (DC 18)
3rd—deep slumber (DC 17), hold person (DC 17), major image (DC 17), suggestion (DC 17)
2nd—alter self, detect thoughts (DC 16), invisibility, minor image (DC 16), mirror image
1st—charm person (DC 15), disguise self, hypnotism (DC 15), mage armor, silent image (DC 15)
0 (at will)—arcane mark, dancing lights, prestidigitation (DC 14), read magic

Arcane School illusion; Opposition Schools abjuration, necromancy

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 13, Con 10, Int 18, Wis 11, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Brew Potion, Eschew MaterialsB, Extend Spell, Iron WillB, Scribe ScrollB, Skill Focus (diplomacy), Skill Focus (Profession [courtesan])
Skills Appraise +8, Bluff +8, Craft (alchemy) +8, Diplomacy +10, Disguise +7, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Knowledge (local) +10, Linguistics +8, Perception +5, Perform (dance) +11, Profession (courtesan) +13, Sense Motive +7, Sleight of Hand +5, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +2, Swim +1
Languages Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Common, Draconic, Elven, Goblin
SQ arcane bonds (object: ring of protection +2), elf blood, extended illusions (+3 rounds)
Gear wand of charm person (heightened 3rd, CL 5th); Other Gear masterwork dagger, circlet of persuasion, ring of protection +2, spell book, spell component pouch
